en.headline: Man injured in suspected knife attack near Tuen Mun convenience store
en.dek: Police found a 61-year-old man with abdomen and hand injuries outside a store on Yan Oi Tong Circuit; a fruit knife was recovered and no arrests have been made.
body: A 61-year-old man was injured in a suspected knife attack near a convenience store in Tuen Mun on Tuesday night. Police received a report from a passer-by at 8.42pm that someone appeared to be injured outside a store on Yan Oi Tong Circuit.

Officers found the man with injuries to his abdomen and hand. He was conscious and taken to Tuen Mun Hospital. Initial investigations suggested he had been attacked with a knife. Police found a fruit knife about 15 centimetres long at the scene, believed to be related to the case.

The injured man is understood to be a Vietnamese national holding a Hong Kong identity card. The case has been classified as wounding and handed to the Tuen Mun police district crime investigation team. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 屯門便利店附近男子疑遭刀襲受傷
zh.dek: 警方在仁愛堂街便利店外發現61歲男子腹部及手部受傷，現場檢獲水果刀，暫無人被捕。
body: 一名61歲男子周二晚上在屯門一間便利店附近疑遭刀襲受傷。警方晚上8時42分接獲途人報案，指仁愛堂街一間便利店外有人受傷。
警員到場發現該男子腹部及手部受傷，神智清醒，被送往屯門醫院。初步調查顯示他疑遭刀襲。警方在現場檢獲一把約15厘米長的水果刀，相信與案件有關。
受傷男子據了解是持香港身份證的越南籍人士。案件列作傷人，交由屯門警區刑事調查隊跟進。暫無人被捕。
